column3: East of Key Lento; northeast of Kenton's dock, past the small islet.
column4: Island Dreams wreck; 10 Gold Doubloons in several dig spots, NOT a Kenton treasure set. Sweep the debris and broken pottery north of the bow; coral ridge to the northeast; mushroom-shaped coral north of the hull; sand inside the open hull. If short, scan the sandy patch by low rocks east of the hull. A dig can award several doubloons. Counts as one Underwater Discovery.

column2: Nuestra Senora de la Etica Laxa
column3: Off Abismo Key, south of Key Lento; use the more southerly dive circle.
column4: 5 relics; same wreck as Kenton set 1400. Golden Pendant inside the broken hull; Golden Chalice south by a crate; Ancient Snuff Box by mast and purple sea fan; Ceremonial Spoon southeast along the timbers; Battered Doubloon in a buried chest beyond the southern coral. Counts as one Underwater Discovery.

column3: South of Key Lento; select the marked circle nearer the island, not Abismo Key.
column4: 7 relics; same wreck as Kenton set 1401. Dragon Pipe beside netting and main mast; Purple Gemstone at stern barrels; Antique Candlestick south near anchor; Ivory Saint along north hull; Pewter Gauntlet north near bow; Serpentine Statue below bow; Stained Doubloon in a seabed chest off the stern. Counts as one Underwater Discovery.

column3: Southeast of Key Lento; just east of the hooked islet, beside the green islands.
column4: 6 relics; same wreck as Kenton set 1402. Ancient Ceremonial Mask in seagrass south of hull; Sacred Necklace southeast by pottery; Golden Glove east by coral; Rusty Doubloon on south midship sand; Ceremonial Plate north against coral-covered rock; Jade-Eye Cup west of bow. Tall hull ribs mark the spot. Pair this dive with nearby Lujuriosa. Counts as one discovery.

column3: Southeast of Key Lento; southwest of the hooked islet, near Cinco Torres.
column4: 6 relics; same wreck as Kenton set 1403. Ceremonial Bowl at southeast stern; Golden Llama on northeast stones; Golden Statuette north by front mast; Ceremonial Knife near bow rocks; Shiny Doubloon northwest by coral; Jade-Lobe Tankard on south hull rocks. Check crossed beams and coral-covered frame. Counts as one Underwater Discovery.

column3: Farther offshore east of Key Lento, beyond the small-island wrecks.
column4: 6 relics; same wreck as Kenton set 1404. Ornate Pocket Watch on north stern remains; Silver Hip Flask east by coral and fallen hull; Brass Spyglass at south bow, west side; Dividing Compass west midship among debris and red sails; Santa Sierra Bell northwest of the red sails; Worn Doubloon north by coral-covered rock. Counts as one Underwater Discovery.
